cli.about: Majordomus control plane: a data-driven MCP server over the repository's .ai/ layer
cli.long_about:
The Rust executable of Majordomus. It reads the repository's provider-neutral AI layer under .ai/ and serves it, read-only, to MCP clients over stdio.

The task lifecycle (init, start, check, finish, doctor, ...) is the shell tool bin/majordomus in the same repository; this executable does not implement those commands.

examples.title: What this checkout is
examples.description: `env` with nothing after it resolves the whole snapshot: the project and its version, the repository and its layer, version control, the toolchains the repository declares, what the layer holds counted per kind, the workflows the runner describes, the provider projections against the policy that renders them, and the local services. This is the resolution that counts the layer, so it builds the index and writes the cache the banner reads.
